annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3365-19 Standard Practice for Compliance Audits to ASTM Standards on Unmanned Aircraft Systems
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3365-19 Standard Practice for Compliance Audits to ASTM Standards on Unmanned Aircraft Systems
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3365-19 is a voluntary standard practice setting minimum requirements for compliance audits against ASTM standards on unmanned aircraft systems, including audit programs, responsibilities and auditor qualifications, e.g. third-party audits of UAS manufacturers' quality assurance systems. The page mixes scope text with shipping information.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets minimum requirements for auditing programs, methods and systems for UAS standards compliance
Defines responsibilities of parties and qualifications of auditing entities
Does not mandate internal or external audits
Audit is only an indicator of compliance health for the period reviewed, not exhaustive
Developed under WTO TBT principles for international standards
